title: Guest Buyer Signs In Elsewhere
h1: Guest-mode buyer on lucasmrichtest, then reinis-test-store: account sign-in and Shop Pay checkout
subtitle: Frames from the Playwright trace of spec 4, attempt 5, run from Erin's machine against production on 2026-09-30. Spec 3 in full, then the same browser signs in to reinis-test-store's customer account through Sign in with Shop and opens a cart permalink there. Frames are unedited screencast stills, except the phone-code frame, which is a test screenshot of the Shop sign-in popup.
store: lucasmrichtest.myshopify.com · shop 60529737962 (checkout on polly-lucas.myshopify.com), then reinis-test-store.myshopify.com · shop 8013840406
override: EXP_OVERRIDES e_ac6fae2281b0e908985ecf9c8069ba5d=treatment (header sent for the whole run)

moments.name: pay-checkout-landed
moments.title: A. Guest mode: straight into Pay checkout
moments.body: Benchmark alias {email} submitted at the Shop Pay sign-in, no phone step. Shipping phone 4385552215 is typed into the address form later; it is never verified in part A.

moments.name: order-confirmed
moments.title: A. Order confirmed on lucasmrichtest
moments.body: Thank-you page, confirmation {order}. The buyer now has a guest-mode Shop account with an unverified phone on the shipping address.

moments.name: account-login-page
moments.title: B. reinis-test-store customer account sign-in
moments.body: /account/login redirects through Sign in with Shop to shopify.com/authentication/8013840406/login. The spec clicks Continue with Shop, which opens a popup at shop.app/accounts/login with authentication_level=email.

moments.name: email-code
moments.title: B. Email code entered in the popup
moments.body: The Shop sign-in popup: email typed, then "Verify your email" with code 000000 entered. The spec confirmed no phone field was present at this point.

moments.name: phone-step-at-sign-in
moments.title: B. Unexpected: Shop then asks for a phone code
moments.body: "Verify your phone, enter code sent to +1 ••• ••• •215": the part A shipping phone 4385552215, never verified. The spec expected an email code only and records this as a soft failure, then enters 000000, which Shop accepts.

moments.name: signed-in
moments.title: B. Signed in to the customer account
moments.body: Popup closed by itself through shop.app/pay/session/create_and_redirect and /customer_authentication/sso_hint. URL is shopify.com/8013840406/account with the Orders heading.

moments.name: reinis-cart-permalink
moments.title: C. Cart permalink goes straight to Shop Pay
moments.body: reinis-test-store /cart/51304521662486:1 redirected: silent OAuth on shopify.com/authentication, back to /cart?shop_sign_in=true, then shop.app/pay/session/create_and_redirect, then /checkout/8013840406/cn/…/shoppay. No merchant checkout page, no Shop Pay button, no email, no phone, no SMS code.

moments.name: reinis-pay-checkout
moments.title: C. Pay checkout on reinis-test-store, fully vaulted
moments.body: {email} in the header, Alice Smith address from part A, Visa ending 5556, Pay now enabled. The spec expected phone verification here and failed waiting for a /checkouts/ URL that never came.

proves: A buyer created through guest mode can sign in to a different store's customer account through Sign in with Shop, but Shop asked for an email code and then an SMS code to the unverified part A shipping phone, not the email code alone.
After that sign-in, opening a cart permalink on reinis-test-store lands the buyer directly in Shop Pay checkout with address and card vaulted, and no phone or SMS verification at all.
All three parts run in one browser, so this is one person continuing, not a competing browser.
caveats: Why part C skipped SMS is inferred, not shown: the phone code accepted in part B most likely verified the shipping phone, so the buyer was already phone-verified when Shop Pay was entered. A run that avoids the part B phone step would settle it, but the popup could not be completed without it.

The direct jump from the cart permalink into Pay checkout happens because the customer account session is present; whether that is the intended experience for a guest-mode buyer is a product question, not something this run decides.
The guest-mode override header is sent for the whole run, including part C. An existing buyer with an order is outside the experiment's gates, so it should not change part C.

Playwright verdict is Failed because of the two soft expectations above; every step otherwise completed. Store lucasmrichtest is on pod 233 (framework warns E2E shops must be on pod 21), so this spec stays local.
Benchmark identity: fixed email code and simulated SMS; one run, one browser.
